The issuer shows extremely strong liquidity (current ratio of 12.41) and very high operating profitability (EBIT of 3,188M on revenue of 7,300M, ~44% margin). However, leverage is also high with equity at only ~10% of total assets (49,234M equity vs 493,319M assets), which limits the upside of the rating despite strong earnings and retained earnings.  

DECISION: A-
